name: Dhruv Patil
headline: Business Analyst
summary: Business analyst with an MSc in Business Analytics (Distinction) and freelance experience helping small businesses understand their problems, document requirements and act on clear performance reporting. I have built Power BI and KPI dashboards for management, produced market, competitor, pricing and cost analysis to support growth decisions, and analysed current processes to find the root causes of inefficiency. With retail floor experience at M&S across stock, replenishment and deliveries, I am keen to help a growing jewellery business improve its operations, systems and commercial performance.
